description: This file defines protected API routes for certificate verification and claiming in the FreeCodeCamp project, including functions for handling certificate logic, user updates, and email notifications.

methods.name: isCertAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a certificate slug is allowed based on current, legacy, and upcoming certifications.

methods.name: renderCertifiedEmail
methods.description: Generates a congratulatory email template for certificate completion.

methods.name: hasCompletedTests
methods.description: Verifies if all required tests are completed by the user.

methods.name: assertTestsExist
methods.description: Asserts that the provided tests array is valid and contains only string IDs.

methods.name: getCertBySlug
methods.description: Retrieves challenge details by certificate slug, validating tests.

methods.name: createCertLookup
methods.description: Creates a lookup object mapping certifications to challenge metadata.

methods.name: getUserIsCertMap
methods.description: Generates a map of user certification flags.
